title: Patent Phrase Similarity Inference via Retrieved Phrase Graphs
summary: This community centers on the 2024 arXiv paper 'Connecting the Dots: Inferring Patent Phrase Similarity with Retrieved Phrase Graphs.' The work is authored by Yi Yang and Zhuoyi Peng and focuses on computational methods for analyzing patent text. It is cited within a broader context of natural language processing and knowledge-intensive tasks.
